title: NextEval: An Agent-Based Solver and Benchmark for Derivative-Free Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2610.36553v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Derivative-free optimization (DFO) addresses problems where derivatives are unavailable or costly to obtain. This setting often arises in simulation-based and experimental applications, where evaluating the black-box objective can itself be costly. Thus, it remains a central challenge in DFO to effectively exploit accumulated observations to select informative evaluation points under a limited budget. In this light, we introduce the NextEval solver, an agent-based DFO solver, which integrates the capabilities of a large language model (LLM) to guide the sequential selection of evaluation points. Specifically, we establish a system that combines an LLM agent with a numerical environment. The environment provides tools for analyzing past evaluations and executing numerical methods, while maintaining a shared evaluation history and method-specific state to support continuation across method switches. translated_title: NextEval：一个基于智能体的无导数优化求解器与基准测试
translated_abstract: 无导数优化（DFO）处理的是导数不可用或获取代价高昂的问题。这种场景常见于基于仿真和实验的应用中，因为评估黑盒目标函数本身可能成本很高。因此，如何在有限的评估预算下，有效利用已积累的观测数据来选择信息量大的评估点，仍然是无导数优化领域的核心挑战。基于此，我们提出了NextEval求解器，这是一个基于智能体的无导数优化求解器，它整合了大语言模型（LLM）的能力来指导评估点的序贯选择。具体而言，我们构建了一个将LLM智能体与数值环境相结合的系统。该环境提供了分析历史评估结果和执行数值方法的工具，同时维护共享的评估历史记录以及特定方法的状态信息，以支持方法切换时的连续性。利用观测数据和工具反馈，
tldr: 该论文提出了NextEval，一个将大语言模型智能体与数值环境相结合的求解器与基准测试，利用LLM指导无导数优化中评估点的序贯选择，从而在有限评估预算下更有效地解决黑盒优化问题。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces NextEval, an agent-based solver and benchmark that combines an LLM agent with a numerical environment to guide the sequential selection of evaluation points in derivative-free optimization, enabling more effective black-box optimization under a limited evaluation budget.
